patch_list: Enables locally executable premium OCR, editing, compression, and password protection tools without cloud or GenAI access.

Disables Adobe Experience Platform MobileCore, EventHub, Adobe Growth SDK (DGP/MAU and Dunamis), Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO), Creative SDK, Branch attribution, Facebook App Events and Audience Network, Firebase Performance, Firebase Sess…
Names new scans 'Scan on [date]' instead of 'Adobe Scan [date]' and removes the attribution text from shared files.
Starts Adobe Scan in its existing account-free local workspace and removes account sign-in gates; Adobe cloud features are unavailable.
Removes promotional, feedback, and broken cloud items from Settings and file menus.
Overrides Adobe Clean fonts across XML layouts, dialogs, and Jetpack Compose screens with the device's system font.
